powered by energy drinks and a concerning amount of open tabs

i don't stop because i'm done. i stop because i'm tired.

deleted more code than i wrote today. productive.

if there's a PCB and a problem i'll be happy for weeks
if it's broken, i'm already fixing it

custom animated OBS scenes. for an audience of zero.
scope creep is a feature
i automate things i could just do manually. it's a gift.
i write firmware. also the backend. also the frontend.
building an open-source robot arm. currently in pieces.

building the tools i wish existed
maker by nature. engineer by necessity.
